text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: So close... I was one step away.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If so much as a mellow breeze had been
blowing
at my back, I might have won.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But still, I won't be satisfied unless I
improve.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The next time those gates open, a gale
will be
unleashed.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I can't rely on the wind to push me
forward. I must
become the wind myself!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm deeply motivated. Let's work
hard
towards winning the next race!
